about_the_game:
Immortal Ascension: Battle of Heaven

-= Game Introduction =-

⚠️ This game supports [简体中文 only]. No English language available.

  • Idle Cultivation: No need to stay online — progress continues even while offline. Gain equal experience, transcend tribulations to advance your realm, and boost your attributes.

  • Engaging Storyline: An enchanting cultivation tale with a dual-heroine setup — choose your destiny.

  • Maze Maps: Whether text-based or visual mazes, everything is available. Lazy explorers can enable auto-exploration.

  • Join a Sect: Master cultivation techniques, forge weapons, refine pills, and take on sect missions.

  • Marketplace: Acquire starter gear and herbs, and take on daily quests.

  • Resource Cave: Mine, gather herbs, and cut wood to enrich your daily life. Strong attribute bonuses help you easily face powerful bosses.

  • Hunting: Use the Heavenly Net to capture mythical beasts.

  • Events: Free destiny encounters, daily Sands of Time rewards.

-= Game Features =-

Abyss Dungeon:

  • Added Abyss Dungeon, accessible through the Hunting Map.

  • Abyss Trials refresh weekly. Clear one floor to challenge the next. Trials may drop Expansion Orders, Fate Shards, rare gear, Violet Demon Cores, and cultivation pills (Essence/Nurturing).

  • Expansion Orders unlock extra storage slots; Fate Shards can be fused into lower- or mid-grade Fates.

  • Defeat Guardian Huangpu Youtian for mysterious loot.

Storage & Artifacts:

  • New Warehouse system — access via Marketplace → Warehouse. Store excess materials safely.

  • New Artifact system — former Spirit Bosses now drop Mystic Stones instead of Spirit Stones. Exchange Mystic Stones in Marketplace → Yamen → Rift Heaven for powerful artifacts.

  • New Cross-Server World Boss — drops Lv.300 weapons, the Dragon Abyss Seven Fiends Sword. Meeting special conditions allows you to exchange for a godly Lv.500 Red Divine Weapon.

  • Pet equipment set Silken Rat Gear adjusted to Lv.150; corresponding team dungeons scaled accordingly.

  • New pet Candle Nine Yin — Fate of Physical Attack, deals 300% single-target attack.

Abyss Trial Assistance:

  • Players can request help once per day; others may accept or ignore. Best to team up with strong allies before asking.

  • Each player can assist twice per day. Successful help grants both loot and instant floor clearance for the requester.

  • Each player can be requested up to 5 times simultaneously. Once full, no further requests can be sent unless they accept/ignore existing ones.

Interactive Features:

  • Added Boss Plunder — on the ranking screen, challenge other players to steal their boss drops.

  • Added Abyss Trials — entry via Hunting → Abyss. Each floor guardian carries treasures, with difficulty increasing per level.

  • Added World Boss — in Abyss → Abyss Secret Realm. Top 5 damage dealers may earn Spirit Stone rewards.

  • Added Team Dungeons — enter the Purple Abyss with a party to slay bosses and obtain exclusive pet gear.

short_description: Immortal Ascension: Battle of Heaven A cultivation-world idle RPG mobile game—gain offline experience, transcend tribulations to boost realm. It has a fantasy storyline (dual heroines), auto-explore mazes, sect play, marketplace, cave resources, and events.
